name: Exception Swallowing Guard
summary: Block newly added empty exception handlers and ignored promise rejections.
description: Recognizes bounded high-confidence empty catch, except, rescue, and promise-rejection handlers and blocks only when the proposed revision adds swallowing behavior.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks newly added empty exception handlers and ignored promise rejections; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not require a particular logging library.
It does not reject handlers that rethrow, return a documented fallback, or record an error.
It does not reject an empty handler documented by a comment, or the `except ImportError`/`ModuleNotFoundError` optional-dependency fallback.
It does not prove that every error path is handled.

entrypoints.purpose: Block newly added empty exception handlers and ignored promise rejections.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block newly added empty exception handlers and ignored promise rejections without deferred work.
